transcript: Why did you tell me Pinarayi Vijayan is the current Chief Minister of Kerala?
response:
I apologize for the confusion. Pinarayi Vijayan was the Chief Minister of Kerala until May two thousand twenty-six. V. D. Satheesan is the current Chief Minister of Kerala, having assumed office on May eighteen, two thousand twenty-six.

Would you like to know more about V. D. Satheesan's political career?
